$comment: All Ohio School District Income Tax (SDIT) districts and their Tax Year 2026 rates. Parsed directly from Ohio Dept of Taxation's own official SDIT_LIST.pdf (5 pages, dated 2025-12-30) via a Python script written and self-validated this session -- NOT hand-transcribed and NOT AI-recalled figures.

taxableWages.basis: Ohio school district income tax is levied on Ohio modified adjusted gross income (ORC 5748.01(E)(1), 'traditional' base) or on wages to the extent included in it (5748.01(E)(2), 'earned income' base). Either way the wage figure is the Ohio state income tax base, so an elective 401(k)/403(b)/457 deferral (excluded from federal and Ohio AGI) DOES reduce it. The engine therefore uses the Ohio state exemptPretax list (data/states/OH-2026.json) for both base types; unlike the municipal and JEDD/JEDZ taxes it has no separate list.

sources.title: Ohio Revised Code 5748.01(E), definition of "taxable income" for school district income tax
sources.quote: "Taxable income" means one of the following, as specified in the resolution imposing the tax: (1) Modified adjusted gross income for the taxable year, as defined in section 5747.01 of the Revised Code, less the exemptions provided by section 5747.025 ... (2) Wages, salaries, tips, and other employee compensation to the extent included in modified adjusted gross income as defined in section 5747.01 of the Revised Code ...

officialTotals.note: ODT's 2025 list states no total; parsedTotals counts the rows transcribed.

parseConfidence: Every SD number, base and rate transcribed from ODT's 2025 list; county/IRN/name carried from the 2026 registry by SD number. East Palestine CSD (1505) and Edon-Northwest LSD (8603) levied in 2025 but not 2026, so their IRN is not captured.
schema: Each entry: county, sdNumber (4-digit school-district number), irn (5-digit Information Retrieval Number), name (district name, often with an embedded expiration/CPT note exactly as Ohio publishes it), rate (decimal, tax year 2025, e.g. 0.0075 = 0.75%), earnedIncomeOnlyBase (true = taxes earned income only; false = traditional MAGI-less-exemptions base), firstYearEffective (the year this district first adopted SDIT, not necessarily when the CURRENT rate took effect if renewed/changed since).

knownGaps: Rate expiration dates are embedded in the free-text name field rather than a structured dated field.

Calculation: ohioSchoolDistrictTax() (src/taxes/state.ts) is wired and computes OH_SDIT off certificate.schoolDistrictCode. Address resolution: geocode/census.ts's fetchSchoolDistrictAtPoint()/fetchSchoolDistrictAtPointSafe() resolve a lat/lon to an Ohio school district via Census's own TIGERweb unified-school-district identify service, consumed by geocode/index.ts's resolveAddress() specifically for OH addresses. Genuinely remaining gap: resolveAddress() only exercises this school-district lookup for Ohio (geographies.state === 'OH'), so a caller resolving a non-OH address never gets a district code back -- structurally fine since only Ohio's SDIT reads one, not a bug.
firstYearEffective is when the district FIRST adopted SDIT, not when the CURRENT 2026 rate took effect if renewed/changed since.
$yearNote: 2025 registry from ODT's 'School Districts With an Income Tax for 2025' list: 210 districts (64 earned-income-only). Differences from 2026: Westerville, Findlay, Kings, Tiffin, Trimble and Clinton-Massie start (or restart) in 2026; Milton-Union, Bowling Green and Coldwater add 2026 levies; East Palestine and Edon-Northwest end after 2025.
